title: Chapter 289
text:
The first season of the Pro League was in full swing. Galaxy Times released the latest episode, analyzing the overall trend of the competition. It received a lot of attention, and the viewership was the highest in history.

Han Xiao clicked on the video. This episode was obviously different. The comments were denser than before, and the duration was twice as long. One look at the progress bar and one could tell that it was full of content.

As usual, after the opening joke, the hosts entered the main topic.

"The first season of the Pro League is here. Registration for the qualifiers is open. Players, are you ready for this grand occasion?"

The bullet screen was filled with the words' always ready '.

The male host said, "From this episode onwards, we will continue to bring you a comprehensive analysis of the competition. This episode will include an explanation of the competition system, an analysis of the competition schedule, and introductions of the strong teams in each division. We have also invited the leaders of the four biggest clubs of China to the studio. Alright, let's start with a small advertisement. Don't go away, the highlights will be back soon."

Then, the advertisement that was not 'small' at all played for five minutes. When the comments started to argue about which brand of baby diapers was better, the faces of the two hosts finally reappeared.

Han Xiao had a helpless expression. No wonder this episode was so long …

"Welcome back. The Pro League is divided into thirteen divisions, corresponding to thirteen novice planets. The strongest teams of each planet will be selected, and the club alliances of some strong esports countries will choose their headquarters. This is equivalent to choosing the main division in advance …"

The two introduced the situation of each division and which strong countries there were. Every time a strong team from a different country was mentioned, there would be a large number of comments shouting the team's slogan. Every strong team had a large number of fans around the world.

When they talked about the Blue Star division, the comments were the most intense. After all, this was the Chinese version of Galaxy Times.

"… Blue Star is the main division of the Chinese clubs. We have invited guests to analyze the Blue Star division for us. Let's welcome Li Ge from Temple of God, Second Prince from Dynasty, Hao Tian from Long Sky, and Sun Eggplant from Fried Eggplants with Fish!"

The comments were in an uproar! Who did not know that the four biggest clubs were rivals? It was a rare scene to see all of them gathered together!

These four were all big shots of the biggest clubs and had a lot of fans. Since they were also rivals, the comments quickly turned into a joyful fight.

"Li Ge is so cool!"

"Temple of God is trash. Fangirls, back off!"

"Don't stop me. I want to bear Li Ge's children!"

"Brothers, we can't lose. F * ck Tiantian, I want to bear your children too!"

"Sun Sun Sun Sun Sun Sun, a pillar holding up the sky, the Facial Paralysis Sect will send you to immortality!"

"Why is Two Club Head here? Where's the boss of Dynasty? I want to see China's number one expert! "

"That's too much! How can you call him Second Club Head? You should call him Second Son!"

With all due respect, all of you here are cowards! "" My Big Brother, forgive me for being blunt. I'll kick you when I see you! "

"Sun Eggplant, Sun Deity!"

Four professional gods with their own specialties appeared on the screen. Li Ge had a warm smile on his face, and he was the most handsome player of the game, so he won the MVP award. Next to him was Haotian. He was expressionless and did not smile. He was like a rock, the kind that came out of a latrine, smelly and hard.

Second Prince was one of the famous players in the Dynasty Club. He was very arrogant. He raised his head and combed his hair with his fingers. His posture was very arrogant, and he could not wait to point his nose at the camera. He explained what it meant to be arrogant.

Among the four of them, Second Prince had the most anti-fans. The number one Almighty in Huaxia belonged to Dynasty. He was very mysterious and almost never appeared on the show. Second Prince liked to talk bad about his Almighty on the show and did not hide his ambition to replace him. However, he was hung up and beaten by his Almighty many times and was treated as a joke. Although he did not change his personality, he did not drag his team down in the competition. Therefore, although he insulted others, it was mostly a joke.

The last one was Sun Eggplant. He was the last member of the "troika" of Fried Eggplant with Fish … I know what you're thinking. The combination of these three people's IDs was indeed "Fried Eggplant with Fish." Sun Eggplant was a middle-aged man wearing a pair of sunglasses. He had a sloppy look on his face as he crossed his legs and shook them nonstop. He had one hand behind the back of the chair, and he looked like a big boss. He even had a toothpick in his mouth … If there wasn't a rule against smoking in front of the camera, he definitely wouldn't be holding a toothpick.

Li Ge smiled. "Thank you for the invitation. Speaking of which, this is the fourth time I'm on the Galaxy Times."

"Thank you for coming to the Galaxy Times," the male host said. "Then, let's invite the four experts to explain the situation of the Blue Star Division to the audience."

They started to analyze. Li Ge and Second Prince spoke the most. Haotian was silent and did not speak at all. Sun Eggplant bit his toothpick and occasionally added a few words.

The Blue Star Division was the home ground of China. There were dozens of clubs in total. Other than the Big Four, there were also large clubs such as Thunder Storm, Fanatics, Nine Gates, and so on. There were also many strong professional players. After a round of comments, it was as if they were discussing the heroes of the world. However, in their words, the Big Four were still the most promising teams.

There were thirteen novice planets and thirty-seven participating countries. The small countries did not have the ability to choose their base camp. There were also some foreign clubs active in the Blue Star Division. Although there were not many of them, they were very strong and could not be underestimated.

Although the so-called base camp planets were self-proclaimed and could be played by any country, this was the territory consciousness that the players formed spontaneously. Han Xiao remembered that some clubs would send experts to other divisions and pretend to be passersby to form a team and defeat the local clubs to gain the right to appear. This way, the local players would be embarrassed, just like a challenge.

Elux, who he had met before, was such a challenge.

"… The preliminaries are the most intense stage. The average participant is around Level 40, and they haven't reached the maximum level yet. The one-battle elimination system means that luck will play a part in this, but the longer you stay, the more battles you will have to go through. Even we don't dare to say that we have absolute confidence in every battle. The element of luck will be greatly reduced, and the last thirty-eight players will definitely be strong teams that have gone through real trials," Li Ge said.

Second Prince mocked, "Ha, that's because you guys from the Temple of God are too weak. We, Dynasty, have absolute confidence. Whoever meets us can only wait for death."

Li Ge smiled, but he was cursing in his heart.

He decided to ignore this idiot and turned to Haotian. He smiled and said, "Old Haotian, can you fulfill your dream this time and become the international champion?"

"Everything depends on effort," Haotian said concisely.

Second Prince scoffed and said arrogantly, "Save it, all of you. Dynasty will definitely be the champion!"

Sun Eggplant glanced at him and said, "Coward."

Second Prince turned around and glared at him.

"Old Haotian Ge, do you want to be taught a lesson?" Sun Eggplant pretended to roll up his sleeves and looked like he was going to pull out his sword and chop him.

"Barbaric." Second Prince shrunk his head and muttered angrily.

The four of them interacted, and the bullet screen was flooded with comments. This episode analyzed the competition in detail. At the end, the four of them promoted their team's preparation and expressed their high fighting spirit and determination to become the champion.

Han Xiao shook his head. Although none of them looked serious, they were all professional gods. They were the kind of people who could kill anyone in the competition. Who could stop them?

Through this episode, the first season of the Pro League in his memory came alive again.

…

The registration for the qualifiers ended quickly, and the official start of the competition was three days later. All the participants were nervously preparing.

At this time, the sanctuary accommodated hundreds of thousands of players. They were squeezed around the arena, and the square was almost overcrowded.

Looking down at the square, the scene of a hubbub of voices came into view.

"Three days to the start of the competition …"

Han Xiao turned around and went downstairs.
